newsitem.title: USA: Four USDA undersecretaries sworn into office.
newsitem.headline: Four USDA undersecretaries sworn into office.

text.p: Four of the top-ranking executives at the U.S. Agriculture Department were sworn into office Tuesday, filling jobs that had been vacant for months.

Gus Schumacher, formerly head of the Foreign Agricultural Service, vowed during the brief ceremony to be "a tireless advocate" for U.S. farmers and the food system as undersecretary in charge of export and domestic farm programs.
Catherine Woteki became the first person sworn into office as undersecretary for food safety. Her predecessor, Mike Taylor, was never formally nominated and left USDA last fall.

Shirley Watkins became undersecretary for nutrition, overseeing two-thirds of USDA spending through programs such as school lunch and food stamps, and Miley Gonzalez became undersecretary for research.
